meta.title: Cyclone Amphan, May 2020: currents for the drift tool, drifters and satellite SST

sources.surf_hycom: HYCOM GOFS 3.1 analysis (GLBy0.08/expt_93.0) surface currents every 6 hours, sampled and averaged onto the 0.5 deg grid like the main snapshot
sources.surf_glorys: Copernicus Marine GLORYS12V1 daily-mean surface currents (0.49 m), native NetCDF-4 read in byte ranges, averaged onto the 0.5 deg grid
sources.drifters: NOAA Global Drifter Program hourly positions (drifter_hourly_qc, AOML ERDDAP) inside the map
sources.sst: NOAA OISST v2.1 (AVHRR only) daily SST at 0.25 deg, extracted as NetCDF from the INCOIS Live Access Server

citations.text: Elipot, S., Sykulski, A., Lumpkin, R., Centurioni, L. and Pazos, M. (2022). Hourly location, current velocity, and temperature collected from Global Drifter Program drifters world-wide. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, dataset, doi:10.25921/x46c-3620. Served by NOAA AOML ERDDAP (drifter_hourly_qc); CC BY 4.0.

Huang, B., Liu, C., Banzon, V., Freeman, E., Graham, G., Hankins, B., Smith, T. and Zhang, H.-M. (2021). Improvements of the Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (DOISST) Version 2.1. Journal of Climate, 34, 2923-2939. NOAA OISST v2.1 (AVHRR only), provided by NOAA PSL and extracted from the INCOIS Live Access Server (las.incois.gov.in).

surf_glorys.read: NetCDF-4 (HDF5) chunks in HTTPS byte ranges by data-pipeline/nc4.py

drifters.drogue: drifters carry a drogue centred at 15 m; drogue_lost_date says when it came off

dataset.name: NOAA High Resolution SST AVHRR only (data provided by the NOAA OAR ESRL)
